name: Bushy Hill Day Camp
description_short: A nature-based day camp for ages 5-12 on a mile-long private lake in Ivoryton, CT. Campers hike, canoe, build shelters, learn outdoor skills and swim under lifeguard supervision in age-based field groups. Summer 2027 runs in five two-week sessions from June 14 to August 20 at $680 each; ages 5-7 join the Saplings groups. AM care, PM care and bus service from eight shoreline towns cost extra.
activities: Water slide, water trampolines, rope swing
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily afternoon waterfront time on a mile-long private lake with a sandy beach and lifeguard-supervised swimming. Certified lifeguards test every camper's swimming at the start of each session and assign swim areas based on ability. A different water activity each day (water slide, water trampolines, or rope swing). There is also a fishing dock for catch-and-release fishing.
refund_policy_summary: Each session has a non-refundable $75 deposit. Cancel more than a month before your first session for a full refund less the deposit; within 4 weeks, 75%; within 3 weeks, 50%; within 2 weeks, 25%; within a week, no refund. No refund for early withdrawal or dismissal for behavior.

source.title: Bushy Hill Camp |Outdoor Adventure & Environmental Education
